responsibility: ELF target configuration header for 32-bit i386 GNU systems, providing the default SysV-style ABI and assembler/linker policy used by the generic x86 backend when emitting ELF output. It sets the startup/endfile sequence, BSS/aligned-BSS emission, local label syntax, debugger register mapping, and pcc struct-return default for the classic 80386 ELF environment.
